snippet.title: (ENGLISH) "The Secret of the Four Winds" PRE-ORDER NOW! (Sega Genesis / Megadrive) Kai Magazine Soft
snippet.description:
A NEW AND LONGER PLAYABLE DEMO AVAILABLE AT THE END OF THE DESCRIPTION. NOW YOU CAN RUN!

WARNING: THIS GAME WILL ONLY COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL MK 1 AND MK 2 SEGA GENESIS / MEGA DRIVE CONSOLES, and the MEGA SG!
MK 3 CONSOLES WILL NOT PLAY ANY MUSIC OF ANY KIND.
CONSOLE CLONES WILL NOT WORK CORRECTLY OR WILL NOT WORK AT ALL (Except for the MEGA SG).
ADD-ONS SUCH AS THE MEGA-CD / SEGA CD or the 32X SHOULD BE REMOVED IF NO MUSIC IS PLAYING.

PRE-ORDERS ARE NOW AVAILABLE AND AT A REDUCED PRICE!
WE SHIP THE PRE-ORDERS IN ORDER OF PAYMENT SO THE SOONER YOU PRE-ORDER, THE SOONER YOU WILL RECEIVE YOUR GAME.
ALSO, THOSE WHO PARTICIPATE IN THE FIRST BATCH OF PRE-ORDERS WILL BE INCLUDED IN THE GAME'S CREDITS!

PRE-ORDER AT OUR STORE:
https://kai-magazine-software.fwscart.com/

IF YOU ORDER OUR OTHER GAMES TOGETHER WITH THE PRE-ORDER, YOU WILL SAVE ON SHIPPING COSTS, AND WE WILL SEND YOU THE GAMES TOGETHER WITH THE PRE-ORDER.
IF YOU WANT TO RECEIVE THE OTHER GAMES SOONER, PLEASE PLACE A DIFFERENT ORDER.

Check the "Retro Gamer Boy" review of the demo with Sega Mega-CD quality music on youtube:

https://youtu.be/P578pl05Q08?si=cHjXYYk5EsULrwWK

"The Secret of the Four Winds" is a Japanese-style action role-playing game (in development) that we have been working on for years.
This game took more work, time and resources than Metal Dragon, Life on Mars and Life on Earth COMBINED.

The cartridge contains a custom board with an audio enhancement chip that offers the possibility to enjoy the game with Sega CD / Mega-CD music quality (No actual Sega CD / Mega-CD is required).
This game will make use of that audio chip but it can also be played with the console's original audio if desired.

This is just the very beginning of the game. Further on the player will control 3 different characters at the same time (the player can control any of the 3 characters at any time and the other characters will be controlled by the CPU). The player can give orders and priorities to the other characters at any time so the companions do what we need them to do.
The game-play is deep, with some strategy and tactics, character development at will (grow a given character as a tank or as an attacker or healer, etc.). The story also begins simple and quite typical, but it will evolve and change quite a lot. The decisions you make during the game will have consequences, etc.

The game should take around 20 to 30 hours to finish (depending on the player) and it has re-playability value since your choices will slightly change some parts of the story and ending.

We expect shipments will begin on early 2025.

THE STANDARD VERSION INCLUDES:

-High quality Genesis/Mega Drive plastic box
-Reversible cover with 2 different art styles
-High quality, full color instructions manual
-A set of postcards with game-art in them 
-A high quality, region free cartridge with label.

THE COLLECTOR'S EDITION INCLUDES:

-High quality Genesis/Mega Drive plastic box
-Reversible cover with 2 different art styles
-High quality, full color instructions manual
-A set of postcards with game-art in them 
-A high quality, region free cartridge with label.
-A BIG BOX (Neo-Geo size) with reversible cover with 2 different art styles
-An art book including concepts, illustrations, in-game maps, enemy designs, etc.
-An engraved wooden box containing an engraved wooden pendrive which contains the 2 soundtracks (enhanced music and FM music) and lots of digital extras such as concepts, illustrations, in-game maps, enemy designs, etc.
-A black bag containing a secret, which should only be opened once you finish the game in order to understand its meaning and avoid spoilers.

GAME FEATURES:

-2 soundtracks: One with Sega CD / Mega-CD quality and another with FM quality.
-Story-rich Action JRPG influenced from classics such as Snatcher, SD Snatcher (MSX2), Shadowrun (SNES) and some touches of Final Fantasy / Chrono Trigger.
-Control 3 characters at the same time, and level them up at will.
-Participate on epic and massive battles.
-Your choices will have consequences.
-Mutant chickens!
-Save game in the cartridge (no battery necessary so you will never lose your progress).
-Cartridge with custom board, with a special sound chip and enhanced capacity.
-3 languages available: English, Japanese and Spanish.
-4 region cover variants
-Reversible covers with 2 different art styles

Video links:

English version:
https://youtu.be/qFa3XklWvJY

Japanese version:
https://youtu.be/y9jt2DvnUTA

Spanish version:
https://youtu.be/KxoXZ3K0Oh8

NEW PLAYABLE DEMO:
https://mega.nz/file/3gR3SIQB#W-jMrBuVLHyluOtqk0vePAgdWZiDjkYnQ3f5RcCQhHs

THE PLAYABLE DEMO WILL WORK ON ALMOST ANY CONSOLE. THE FINAL GAME WILL NOT.
THE FINAL GAME WILL ONLY BE COMPATIBLE WITH THE ORIGINAL MK 1 AND MK 2 SEGA GENESIS / MEGA DRIVE CONSOLES and MEGA SG
MK 3 CONSOLES WILL NOT PLAY ANY MUSIC OF ANY KIND.
Thank you for your support!

0:00 Enhanced music
26:10 FM music (Genesis / Mega Drive sound chip)
